title: Gate readiness spotcheck: 1:1 summaries and action log
content:
Purpose: quick, portable notes from 1:1 spotchecks with feature owners ahead of Friday's release-train go/no-go. Use this as the single-source for items I will escalate in the readiness huddle.

High-level summary (my read):
- Overall posture: green-to-yellow. Most owners confident on QA and smoke, but two infra items and one data migration remain low-confidence.
- Primary risk vectors: 1) cache invalidation sequence for model cache (could cause higher latency on first ramp), 2) gating of private deployment images in eu-west (registry auth flakiness), 3) eval regression on reranker config (small but unexplained precision drop).

1:1 spotcheck notes (condensed)
- Ethan Moore (serving-runtime): smoke ok on x86 and T4; kernel selection test failure on one p100 host (REL-4012). Root cause suspected: driver mismatch after node image update. Action: Ethan to pin driver and run canary by 2026-03-09 EOD.
- Lina Rodriguez (console & rollouts): rollout UI gating and canary route config ready; she flagged missing feature toggle for automatic fallback (OPS-3980). Action: Lina to attach toggle PR and QA checklist by 2026-03-10 midday.
- Samir Patel (private-deployments): eu-west registry auth flaky in staging (timeout errors ~10%). He asked for support from infra. Action: Samir to open short-lived SSH session for infra to repro and to add retry logic; target 2026-03-10 afternoon.
- Maya Chen (observability): dashboards updated; tracing shows a spike in tail latencies at sequence boundary for one test set. Maya to add a focused trace filter and re-run traces by 2026-03-09.
- Leah Ortiz (quality & evals): reranker precision dip on corpus A (0.78 -> 0.74). Leah suspects dataset sampling skew during eval harness run. Action: Leah to re-run with fixed seed and share raw examples by 2026-03-09.

Go/No-Go checklist snapshot (quick pass)
- Safety & policy signoff: pending (security review scheduled 2026-03-10) -> tentatively yes if no new findings.
- Infra stability: partial (infra spike items above) -> yellow.
- Rollout automation: green (canary + rollback config present).
- Data migrations: red -> need migration dry-run completed before final GO.
- Observability/tracing: yellow -> missing a targeted trace filter for the tail latency case.

Priority escalation items (what I'll call out in the readiness huddle)
1) Data migration dry-run: owner Leah Ortiz, blocking for final GO. Target: dry-run complete by 2026-03-11 AM.
2) Registry auth in eu-west: owner Samir Patel + infra on-call. If not fixed by 2026-03-10 PM, plan fallback to eu-central for initial rollout.
3) Kernel/driver mismatch on P100 host: owner Ethan Moore. If canary fails again by 2026-03-09 EOD, revert node image change or exclude host from pool.
4) Reranker regression root-cause: owner Leah Ortiz. If re-run confirms regression, revert reranker config to previous stable variant for rollout.

Notes to self / follow-ups:
- Remind Lina to add the toggle PR link into the release checklist before the huddle.
- Draft a two-line escalation note for SRE channel summarizing eu-west auth issue + potential fallback.
- Double-check that release train rollback playbook PR has been merged (GH PR referenced above).

Action log (owner | action | due | status)
- Ethan Moore | pin driver + canary run on affected host | 2026-03-09 | in_progress
- Lina Rodriguez | PR for auto-fallback toggle + QA checklist | 2026-03-10 | in_progress
- Samir Patel | repro session + retry logic for registry auth | 2026-03-10 | open
- Leah Ortiz | migration dry-run + eval re-run with fixed seed | 2026-03-11 | open
- Maya Chen | add trace filter + re-run tail traces | 2026-03-09 | in_progress

Quick agenda for readiness huddle (Friday 09:00 PT)
1) One-line go/no-go status from each owner (30s each)
2) Highlight escalations (me) (5 mins)
3) Decision triggers and fallback plan review (5 mins)
4) Timeboxed Q/A and next steps (10 mins)

Open questions I still have:
- Would product accept an initial eu-central-only rollout if eu-west auth remains flaky? (need product confirmation by 2026-03-10)
- Are the migration rollback scripts tested on the same data volume profile as prod? If not, add to dry-run checklist.

If anything changes during the week I'll update this doc and push the single-line summary into #release-train (short post + link).

End of notes.
